description: This file defines the Coocook::Model::Authorization Perl module, which manages authorization rules and capabilities based on user roles and permissions within the application. It includes rules for various actions such as viewing projects, editing organizations, managing permissions, and user roles, along with methods to check capabilities and roles.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Authorization
classes.description: Main class providing authorization logic, including rules for capabilities and role checks.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Singleton constructor for the Authorization class.

methods.name: capability_exists
methods.description: Checks if a specific capability is defined.

methods.name: capability_needs_input
methods.description: Returns the list of input keys required for a given capability.

methods.name: has_capability
methods.description: Determines if a user has a specific capability given the input context.

methods.name: organization_roles
methods.description: Returns the list of roles within an organization.

methods.name: project_roles
methods.description: Returns the list of roles within a project.
